Supplier Statements — Unpaid invoices

The supplier statement unpaid invoices view provides a comprehensive overview of all outstanding purchase invoices for a specific supplier.

This statement helps you track which invoices remain unpaid and how long they have been outstanding, making it easier to manage your accounts payable and maintain good supplier relationships.

Statement Details

The statement displays each unpaid invoice with the following information:

• Date - The issue date of the invoice

• Invoice - The invoice reference number

• Description - A brief description of what the invoice is for

• Invoice Total - The original amount of the invoice

• Overdue - The number of days the invoice is past its due date

• Balance Due - The current amount still owed on the invoice

Aging Analysis

At the bottom of the statement, an aging analysis breaks down your total outstanding balance into categories based on how overdue the invoices are:

• Current - Invoices that are not yet due

• 1-30 days overdue - Invoices overdue by 1 to 30 days

• 31-60 days overdue - Invoices overdue by 31 to 60 days

• 61-90 days overdue - Invoices overdue by 61 to 90 days

• 90+ days overdue - Invoices overdue by more than 90 days

This aging breakdown helps you prioritize which invoices to pay first and identify any long-overdue amounts that need immediate attention.

To configure the report parameters, see: Supplier Statements — Unpaid invoices
